title: Identity verification required for directors, PSCs and authorised agents
summary: Since 18 November 2025, directors, people with significant control and authorised agents must verify their identity with Companies House. The 12-month transition period has ended. Failing to comply may be an offence.
what_changes: Directors and their equivalents, including LLP members, and PSCs must verify their identity and link their personal code to each role.
New directors must give their personal code when appointed. New PSCs must give it when added to the register or within 14 days.
Authorised Corporate Service Providers (ACSPs) must be AML-supervised and registered with Companies House to verify identities for others.
Acting as a director without verifying is an offence. Penalties include prosecution, fines or financial penalties.
who_it_applies_to: Firms acting for companies or acting as Companies House authorised agents, and LLP firms whose members must verify their identity.

history.event: Companies House updated its guidance for the end of the 12-month identity verification transition period.
